name: Sylvie Scott
source:
He is the God of Love, Cupid, born anew after [spoiler]Lynette became human[/spoiler]. He is a naive man who takes great pride in his role as Cupid. He admires the previous Cupid, who was full of initiative.

[Translated/edited from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/cp/fd/chara/sylvie.php]official website[/url]]
